clips.title: The story
paras: Pilot Longbeard is a dwarven siege engine pilot of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, stationed in the Hall of Arms within Ironforge's Military Ward. Though posted in the mountain city, he maintains close ties with gnomish tinkerers and fellow racing enthusiasts operating far away in the Shimmering Flats.

Found amongst the martial displays and weaponsmiths of Ironforge's Military Ward, Pilot Longbeard represents the proud siege engine corps of Khaz Modan. While his duties keep him within the fortress city, Longbeard keeps an eager ear out for innovations and news from fellow mechanics across the continent, including the Brassbolts brothers tinkering out on the salt flats of Kalimdor.

Longbeard serves as a point of contact for adventurous travelers heading south into Kalimdor. He frequently directs promising recruits and couriers toward the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles, where gnomish inventors push mechanical boundaries alongside their goblin rivals.
